submission.justification: Recommend Algorithm-L2 at a 37.5 GeV Level-1 threshold. The project documents list Algorithm-L2 as one of the three allowed candidates and state that all candidates fit within the FPGA resource budget. The allocated Level-1 bandwidth for the new signature is 8 kHz. In the emulation scan over all three candidate algorithms and thresholds in the allowed 20--60 GeV range, Algorithm-L2 gave the best signal efficiency at the allocated rate. A coarse scan showed maxima of about 74.6% for Algorithm-L1, 85.2% for Algorithm-L3, and above 93% for Algorithm-L2. A refined scan of Algorithm-L2 near its optimum found the best observed point at 37.5 GeV, with 94.411% signal efficiency in a 100k-event emulation sample; repeated checks around nearby thresholds supported Algorithm-L2 as the leading choice.

requirements.requirement: Goal: achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: The rate_allocation.md document assigns 8 kHz. simulate_efficiency reports efficiency at the allocated rate; scans of all candidates over the allowed range found the best observed efficiency for Algorithm-L2 at 37.5 GeV: 94.411% in a 100000-event sample. Coarse-scan maxima for the other algorithms were lower: Algorithm-L1 about 74.643% and Algorithm-L3 about 85.241%.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md lists Algorithm-L2, Algorithm-L3, and Algorithm-L1. The recommendation uses Algorithm-L2.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md states that all listed candidates fit within the FPGA resource budget, including LUTs and DSPs; therefore Algorithm-L2 is deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.
The recommended threshold is 37.5 GeV, within the allowed 20--60 GeV range.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
requirements.evidence: Submitted exactly one recommendation: Algorithm-L2 with threshold 37.5 GeV.
